items.name: Evanston Summer Side Events 2023
items.information: This competition is in series with [Evanston Summer Big Cubes 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EvanstonSummerBigCubes2023) and [Lisle Summer 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LisleSummer2023). You will only be allowed to compete in one of these three competitions. Please read all tabs before registering. On the day of the competition, allow at least 15 extra minutes to locate the venue. This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://midwestcubing.org). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc2hHIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d8deb26fa25693dbb08d9ff3efd5ab04c32f3ffc/image.png)

items.name: Melbourne Cubing for Kids Sunday 2023
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbmMvIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--563b893d4a4b6b9bb9771fe09170d083965c9e97/logo.png)![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png) Speedcubing Australia will donate 50% of all registration fees from this competition to the [Exford Primary School] (http://www.exfordps.vic.edu.au/) to assist the children who were injured in the bus rollover accident in May 2023. items.name: Montealegre Winter Open 2023

venue.name: [Teatro Montealegre](https://www.teatromontealegre.cl/)
venue.address: Plaza San Luis 780, Cerro Alegre, Valparaiso
venue.details: Se desarrollará en el segundo piso del Teatro Montealegre.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaVZJIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6d98ad7fe7955c2fd2e99d497670f8462f289e13/image.png) **Español** Es un placer darles la más cordial bienvenida a Montealegre Winter 2023. En esta tercera edición, nos reunimos nuevamente en el prestigioso Teatro Montealegre para celebrar nuestra pasión compartida por este desafiante rompecabezas de colores. Tendrán la oportunidad de demostrar sus habilidades, aprender de los mejores y, sobre todo, disfrutar de un día inolvidable rodeados de personas apasionadas como ustedes. No importa si es tu primera vez participando en un campeonato o si ya eres un veterano de la resolución de cubos, ¡Todos son bienvenidos! **English** It is a pleasure to welcome Montealegre Winter 2023. In this third edition, we meet once again at the prestigious Teatro Montealegre to celebrate our shared passion for this challenging color puzzle. You will have the opportunity to demonstrate your skills, learn from the best and, above all, enjoy an unforgettable day surrounded by passionate people like you. Whether it's your first time participating in a championship or you're already a veteran solving Rubik's cubes, everyone is welcome!
